howItWorks.title: From one tap to <g>tangible change</g>
howItWorks.sub: Scroll to follow a single 2-cent donation on its journey through the network.

steps.title: A driver fills up
steps.body: At any KDCharité-integrated pump, the terminal asks a single question: "Add 2% to help your community?" One tap. No app, no account, no friction.

steps.title: The levy is verified
steps.body: Each micro-donation is timestamped, hashed, and written to our public ledger the instant the transaction settles — verifiable by anyone, instantly.

steps.title: Funds pool city-wide
steps.body: Thousands of 2-cent gifts merge with digitized church tithes into a transparent community fund, allocated to vetted local programs every month.

steps.title: Impact reaches the street
steps.body: Food banks restock, mobile clinics roll out, wells get dug. Every donor sees the precise outcome their generosity produced, down to the neighborhood.

testimonials.title: Generosity, <g>in their words</g>
testimonials.sub: Drivers, pastors, station owners, and neighbors — the people who make and feel the 2%.

items.quote: I never used to give — I always meant to, but the moment never came. Now every time I fill up, I give. It's automatic, it's tiny, and somehow it adds up to something I'm proud of.
Our congregation could never see where the offering went. With KDCharité, every member opens their phone and watches their tithe turn into clinic visits two streets over. Trust changed everything.
As a station owner I worried it would slow the line. It added zero seconds. My customers love seeing our station on the public board — it became the thing the neighborhood talks about.
The mobile clinic that KDCharité funds caught my daughter's pneumonia early. Two cents at a time, from people I'll never meet, kept her healthy. I cry thinking about it.

faq.title: Everything you <g>might ask</g>
faq.sub: Transparency starts with answering the hard questions plainly.

items.a: Never. It is always opt-in, prompted once per transaction with a single tap. Drivers can decline with no penalty and no nagging.

items.q: Where does my money actually go?
items.a: 100% of every donation reaches the community fund — KDCharité's own operations are grant-funded. The fund is allocated monthly to independently vetted local programs, and every cent is traceable on our public ledger.

items.q: How do I know it's real?
items.a: Each donation is hashed and written to a public, append-only ledger the moment it settles. We undergo an annual independent CPA audit and publish 990-ready reports anyone can inspect.
Yes. Any congregation can request access to the digital tithe portal — mobile giving pages, QR codes, and a per-member impact dashboard, all under your own brand. Onboarding takes under a week.
KDCharité is a registered 501(c)(3). Donations are tax-deductible to the extent permitted by law, and you receive an annual consolidated receipt.

items.q: What does it cost a fuel station to participate?
items.a: Nothing. The SDK embeds into major pump management systems with no hardware changes, and there are no fees. Stations receive a branded monthly impact report for community display.
